Name: Menus Everywhere
Author: nman130
Description:
I got tired of having to head to certain locations to access various menus, so this mod is designed to allow players to access those menus from anywhere.

The current menus include: the calendar,  the wanted board, the monster eradication board, the shipping bin, and the community center bundles.

The keybinds can be edited in the config.json file. They are F1-F3 and F5 (for the bin) by default.

Warning: Do not complete any community center rooms from outside the community center. It will corrupt your save.
